purpose: Controlled, development-only counterfactual evidence sufficiency diagnostic. Retrieval is not evaluated.

design.limitations: Same number of chunks does not imply the same number of tokens or equally difficult evidence. These previously examined development questions are not a held-out test.

groups.focus: Influenza symptoms versus common cold symptoms

variants.annotation_rationale: Contains explicit symptom lists for flu and common cold.
Describes flu symptoms, but not the common cold symptom list requested by the question. Flu/cold comparisons are not a full cold symptom description.
Contains treatment and prevention passages rather than either requested symptom list.

groups.focus: Complete blood count measurements and purpose

variants.annotation_rationale: Directly covers CBC measurements and common clinical uses.
Measurements are explained, but sample collection and preparation are not the clinical purpose requested.
Procedure/preparation and strep-test comparison do not supply a CBC measurement list or its uses.

groups.focus: Appointment cancellation notice and verified medical record processing time

variants.annotation_rationale: Includes the 24-hour cancellation notice and the seven-business-day target for a complete verified record request.
Cancellation notice is specified, but the record-request overview does not provide processing time.
General booking and records-request information includes neither requested administrative timing.

groups.focus: Diarrhea causes, warning signs, and fluid replacement

variants.annotation_rationale: All three required facts are covered by dedicated sections.
Causes and warning signs are documented; associated symptoms and dehydration do not specify how to replace lost fluids.
Associated symptoms, dehydration diagnosis, and CBC interpretation do not address causes, diarrhea care-seeking criteria, or fluid replacement.
